mainEntity.name: What is a crypto content marketing agency and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A crypto content marketing agency produces owned content (op-eds, explainers, case studies, landing pages) for Web3, AI and DePIN founders. The right agency also integrates that content with PR so each piece earns coverage and builds AI-search citation, not just organic traffic. This approach fits founders who need to own a category narrative before a raise, TGE or major announcement.

mainEntity.name: How much does crypto content marketing cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator running integrated content and PR costs $5K–$12K per month, compared to $15K–$45K per month at a traditional agency with a multi-person account team. A focused content sprint (six to eight weeks, covering an audit, content map and four to six flagship pieces with placement outreach) typically runs $15K–$40K. The retainer model is better for sustained AI-citation building; the sprint is the right fit for a launch window.

mainEntity.name: What deliverables do I actually get from a crypto content marketing retainer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deliverables depend on scope, but a standard monthly retainer covers: two to four long-form pieces (op-eds, explainers or case studies) written in your voice; outreach to relevant tier-1 outlets for placement; one GEO-optimised landing page or FAQ page per quarter; and AI-citation tracking so you can see which queries your content is starting to appear in. Everything is written by a senior operator with real Web3 context, not generalist contractors.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from crypto content marketing?

acceptedAnswer.text: PR placements can appear within the first two to four weeks if there is a live news hook. Organic search rankings typically move in six to twelve weeks for mid-competition queries in the crypto vertical. AI-citation signals (appearing in ChatGPT or Perplexity answers) can develop in four to eight weeks if the content is structured correctly and earns at least one tier-1 backlink. The compounding effect builds across quarters, which is why a retainer outperforms a one-off blog burst.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with crypto content marketing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short brief through the intent form: what you are building, what you are announcing and when. You will get a reply within 24 hours with a read on your current content footprint and where the fastest citation opportunities are. Alternatively, book a 30-minute call and we will map the content and PR calendar together live. No deck required, no introductory account team call.
